text:
Asia/Shanghai is UTC+8, Europe/London in 1715 would be using local mean time (approx. UTC-0:01:15) but effectively treated as UTC for simplicity.  
2 AM Shanghai = 2:00 - 8 hours = 18:00 previous day UTC.  
18:00 UTC = 18:00 London (approx).  
So in London it is 18:00 (6:00 PM) on May 13, 1715.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1715-05-13 18:00
